messages:
kevin: Heads-up: Marlinix private cutover tomorrow 08:00 PT. Dry-run shows some audit bundles (VPC Flow + CloudTrail) not arriving in their SIEM. Can infra/sec triage? @li @sam :eyes:

tara: Only audit bundles or also app request logs? Need to know scope before we message the CSMs.

li: Triage: our cross-account forwarder assumes their role and writes to their S3 with SSE-KMS. Replayed a put-object and saw KMS GenerateDataKey -> AccessDenied. CloudTrail error shows "AccessDenied" on kms:GenerateDataKey.

sam: Likely key policy scoping. Customers often lock down with aws:PrincipalOrgID or aws:SourceAccount which blocks our execution chain. If logs miss the retention window, that's a renewal risk.

kevin: Can we get a quick mitigation and ETA? CS needs a short message for the customer and AMs.

li: Proposed minimal fix: add a single-statement allow for the exact redwood forwarder role, actions kms:GenerateDataKey & kms:Encrypt, scoped to the key ARN and the customer's S3 source ARN. I'll validate in staging. Snippet:

```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodForwarder",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFW:role/log-forwarder"},
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Encrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444455556666:key/ghi-789",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "444455556666","aws:SourceArn": "arn:aws:s3:::marlinix-logs-*"}}
}
```

I'll run staging test in ~20m.

ops-bot: Job queued: forwarder-staging -> marlinix (job 9902). ETA ~15m.

tara: For customer comms: keep it concise and clear on risk/mitigation. Draft: "During a pre-cutover dry-run we found your KMS policy blocked Redwood's log-forwarder which prevented some audit logs from reaching your SIEM. We're applying a tightly-scoped policy update in staging and will roll to prod after validation. If you prefer immediate coverage we can enable a Redwood-managed key temporarily. We'll confirm status within 3 hours."

sam: Security note: policy must not widen permissions beyond that principal and actions; add aws:SourceAccount and pin the resource ARN. If we use managed-key fallback it must be short-lived and auditable.

li: Staging test: put-object + GenerateDataKey succeeded, CloudTrail shows success. Pushed CSR tag CSR-3851 for prod change.

ops-bot: Deployment succeeded: forwarder-staging (job 9902). Proposing prod change window 2h.

sam: Reviewed CSR-3851: approve with resource locked to key ARN and principal fixed. Approve prod patch during maintenance window.

kevin: Great. Tara please send CS note and flag renewal-watch for AMs (if logs missing >24h escalate to renewals). Owner:li, blocker:resolved-in-staging, next: prod-roll (ETA 2h). :white_check_mark:
